title: How Teens with No Criminal History Became WANTED Criminals Instantly
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On October 16, 2023, deputies were informed of a stolen vehicle traveling through Fond du Lac, WI. The vehicle was reported to have been involved in an armed carjacking in another county earlier that morning, which led to a pursuit. The vehicle eventually crashed, and the suspects proceeded to steal another car. They were quickly found in a parking lot and surrounded by several deputies. It was later discovered that the 18-year-old couple had no prior criminal records.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
